equity.equity_measurement: VFC groups are from program data by age 17 years; MarketScan completion is by age 19 years and cannot include VFC-eligible adolescents, so the strata are not directly comparable.

notes: Immunogenicity comes from multinational trials (about 30% US recipients), and completion figures come from US claims and VFC data. The hSBA assay and fourfold-rise seroresponse cutoff are measurement steps, not procedures, and no test or model is reported. For MenB-FHbp, VFC-eligible completion is lower (16.2% vs 35.5%), but for MenB-4C it is similar (51.4% vs 49.6%); the text does not comment on this.
